question: Why is Project Phoenix over budget?
summary: Project Phoenix is ₹18.4 lakh (12%) over its approved budget of ₹1.53 crore.

answer.text: Project Phoenix is ₹18.4 lakh (12%) over its approved budget of ₹1.53 crore.
Half (₹9.2 lakh, facade) comes from “Front facade in HPL instead of ACP”.
About a third (₹6.1 lakh, structural steel) comes from “Level-2 transfer beam in steel (ISMB 600)”.
The rest (₹3.1 lakh, site labour) comes from “Keep masonry and MEP crews on site during the steel delay” — a draft decision not yet confirmed.
Variation order VO-07 (facade ACP → HPL) is not yet billable: it is still unsigned.

causes.text: Front facade in HPL instead of ACP.
Keep masonry and MEP crews on site during the steel delay (draft, not yet confirmed).

risks.text: ₹9.2 lakh cannot be billed until the variation is signed.
Change order SS-CO-02 not passed to the client (₹6.1 lakh).

unknowns: Whether the ₹6.1 lakh change order can be billed to the client — no client variation found.
Costs incurred after 30 Sept are not in the ledger yet.

confidence.reason: Figures come from the ledger; one cause rests on a draft decision that is not yet confirmed.
